lineage.reason_for_new_version: Replace unprovable exact-first-public and vendor-actual assumptions with independent actual evidence and a conservative known-public-by activation contract.

objective: Test whether a source-qualified point-in-time quarterly EPS forecast error predicts post-announcement drift after frozen multiple-testing and economic-cost rules.

event_universe.source: candidate-grade SHARADAR/SF1 ARQ and SHARADAR/TICKERS snapshots
event_universe.security_lineage_rule: Join each distinct SF1 ticker and reportperiod to exactly one dated TICKERS row and positive permaticker. Group the joined rows by CIK and fiscal period. An issuer-period mapping to more than one permaticker is excluded as ambiguous; no primary share class is guessed.
event_universe.revision_rule: Multiple SF1 ARQ rows for one ticker and reportperiod are one event-census lineage with every source row retained; no SF1 EPS value or datekey supplies the signal actual or announcement time.
event_universe.missing_identity_rule: Missing CIK, ticker, permaticker, lifecycle, or contradictory interval evidence is an explicit identity-gap disposition.

source_independence.market_accounting_lane: Sharadar supplies event census lineage, security identity and lifecycle, SEP prices, dated size inputs, and separately qualified economic-return evidence only.
source_independence.consensus_lane: A licensed point-in-time estimates source supplies raw consensus vintages and analyst counts through a registered byte-replay adapter.
source_independence.announcement_lane: Issuer releases and/or SEC-filed issuer exhibits supply the reported actual; a separately trusted distribution or prospective observation receipt supplies only a known-public-by upper bound.
forbidden_cross_fill: Sharadar SF1 values or datekey may not supply actual EPS, consensus, analyst count, or announcement activation.
Consensus-provider actuals or report times may not satisfy the independent announcement lane.
SEC acceptance, PDS build time, HTTP Date, or later retrieval may not be relabeled as exact global first-public time.

signal_rule.consensus_selection: Select the latest unambiguous provider vintage with provider_as_of_date strictly before the known-public-by America/New_York calendar date.
signal_rule.activation_semantics: conservative upper bound; never exact first-public
signal_rule.historical_activation_source: licensed release-distribution archive with provider-attested distribution time and trusted provider-manifest hash
signal_rule.prospective_activation_source: precommitted live SEC/PDS or licensed-release observer with raw response replay and an externally trusted append-only checkpoint
signal_rule.preannouncement_price: The unique latest positive SHARADAR/SEP close on an observed NYSE session whose session date is strictly before the activation's America/New_York date.
signal_rule.execution_price_evidence: Retain closeunadj from the exact selected SEP row separately from split-normalized close; it is not the signal denominator.
signal_rule.metric_reconciliation: Actual and consensus must match metric, accounting basis, per-share basis, scope, canonical share basis, currency, unit, and metric-definition digest exactly; no implicit GAAP/non-GAAP or share-basis conversion is allowed.
signal_rule.missing_or_ambiguous_data: Exclude the event without imputation or fallback and preserve the blocker code.

prospective_commitment.consensus_snapshot_deadline: no later than the selected prior NYSE session close

portfolio_rule.formation_session: first observed SEP session of each calendar month
portfolio_rule.tie_break: ascending positive permaticker after signal sort

statistical_family.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across the exact eight-cell family
statistical_family.inference: one-sided positive-spread HAC inference with dependence length covering the holding horizon
statistical_family.robustness_diagnostic: one-percent within-formation return winsorization reported separately from raw economics

economic_and_execution_boundary.edge_claim_requires: independent implementation reconciliation and a cost-net result surviving the frozen statistical family
economic_and_execution_boundary.prospective_edge_claim_requires: separately committed prospective accumulation after this protocol and its exact source adapters are frozen
economic_and_execution_boundary.paper_execution_requires: qualified edge evidence plus borrow, locate, calibrated costs, capacity, kill switches, immutable paper ledger, and explicit approval
economic_and_execution_boundary.live_execution_requires: successful controlled paper evidence, independent review, separate live approval, minimal capital limits, and automatic rollback

stop_rules: Stop if raw-byte replay cannot reproduce every selected consensus value, analyst count, source membership, and disposition.
Stop if independent actual and consensus metric semantics do not match exactly.
Stop if announcement activation or strictly prior denominator evidence is missing or ambiguous.
Stop if security identity, lifecycle, corporate-action, delisting, borrow, or cost evidence remains unresolved for an executable claim.
Stop if the independently reconstructed primary signal reverses sign.
Stop if no cost-net cell survives the frozen BH family or pooled_63 is nonpositive.
